gt_source: Section 3.1: 'BASIC LIFE: Your basic benefit equals 2 times your annual base salary, rounded to the next higher $1,000. Benefits will be paid within 10 business days of receipt of complete claim documentation.'
evidence_text: Benefits will be paid within 10 business days of receipt of complete claim documentation.

gt_source: Article I, 1.2: 'DEATH BENEFIT TRIGGER: The death benefit is payable only upon the death of the SECOND insured to die (survivorship basis). If the first insured dies, no death benefit is paid and the policy continues in force covering the surviving insured.'
evidence_text: If the first insured dies, no death benefit is paid and the policy continues in force covering the surviving insured.

gt_source: Section 8.1: 'SUICIDE: If death occurs by suicide within 12 months of the coverage effective date, we will not pay a death benefit.'
evidence_text: 8.1 SUICIDE: If death occurs by suicide within 12 months of the coverage effective date, we will not pay a death benefit.
